apps.name: SpotIt
apps.summary: كتم بث إعلان الموسيقى
apps.desc_ar:
Want to avoid ads in spotify, jiosaavn or gaana, then this app is for you.

SpotIT is simple app that detects advertisements in music streaming apps and mutes them so your work doesn't get interrupted by ads.

The app works with popular music streaming services like Spotify, JioSaavn and Gaana.

* Mute ads in Spotify, JioSaavn and Gaana
* Simple and Intituive UI
* FOSS Forever

Privacy:

* The app does not collect any private data nor it requires any network permissions.
* It uses user notifications to detect advertisements in music streaming services and does not "hack" protection measures of music streaming services

apps.name: Diab
apps.summary: مدير ذكي لمرض السكري ، سجل سكر الدم وجرعات الأنسولين ، تصدير اختياري
apps.desc_ar:
Diab is a smart opensource application that helps you managing your diabetes by
keeping track of your glucose values and insulin injections.

 • Save records of glucose and insulin dosages
 • Smart insulin suggestions through plugins
 • Export records as Excel file
 • Reminders to check in case of hypoglycemia
 • Dark mode

Insulin plugin: using the data registered inside the app it's possible to generate a
customized plugin that once applied to the app will provide smart insights
for insulin dosages based on real-time context.

Information on how to use this feature can be found on the 
project's repository.

apps.name: DozenCalc
apps.summary: حاسبة عشرية (اثنا عشرية، أو قاعدة اثني عشر)
apps.desc_ar:
A dozenal (duodecimal, or base-twelve) calculator with both
simple and scientific modes. Simple mode (automatically
chosen when in portrait orientation) contains the four
functions, square roots, exponents, and parentheses for
grouping, and operates to four digits of fractional
accuracy. Scientific mode (automatically chosen when in
landscape orientation) has all of the same features, plus
trigonometric functions and their inverses, logarithms,
reciprocals, buttons for pi and the base of the natural
logarithm, and variable precision allowing the user to
select the number of fractional digits desired.

apps.name: RailTrip
apps.summary: سافر عبر محطات القطار لختم التأشيرة !
apps.desc_ar:
RailTrip is a new way to discover new stations in a fun way. Travel from station to station to fill your visa with stamps. The ultimate goal? Visit all the stations around the world!

Currently contains many urban networks as well as stations in France, Belgium, Switzerland, Luxembourg, Spain, Portugal and Ireland. Do you want to have this application for your city? Send us your request by e-mail and it may be part of an updates ;)

The application is a friend of your privacy, no information on the stamped stations leaves your device :)

The application logo was made with icons from fontawesome.io

apps.desc_ar:
StudyDesk تطبيق لتنفيذ الدراسة للطلاب.

الميزات:
* أدخل مقرراتك ومواعيدك النهائية، ومحرك "التالي" يرتّب ما يجب فعله الآن

apps.name: ConnectBot
apps.summary: عميل SSH بسيط وقوي ومفتوح المصدر.
apps.desc_ar:
ConnectBot is a secure shell client for Android that lets you connect to remote servers over a cryptographically secure link.

Use ConnectBot to manage SSH sessions from your phone or tablet, keep connections active while you switch apps, and work with the terminal tools you already use. It supports saved hosts, SSH public key authentication, port forwarding, terminal color schemes, custom fonts, and other settings for tailoring each connection.

The F-Droid build uses the open-source ConnectBot flavor. It includes the cryptography provider in the APK and does not depend on Google Play Services.

apps.name: Flash Alert (Calls & SMS)
apps.summary: وميض الطرفية عند تلقي مكالمة أو رسالة نصية أو إشعار تطبيق
apps.desc_ar:
Flash Alert turns your camera flash into a powerful visual indicator whenever you receive a call, SMS/MMS, or notification from another app (WhatsApp, social media, etc.).

Key Features:
- Customizable flash alerts for calls, messages, and apps.
- Contact filtering: enable the flash only for your contacts.
- Battery-saver mode: smart deactivation if the phone is face down or if the screen is already on.
- Night mode and "Do Not Disturb" override options.
- Ambient noise detection (for compatible Android versions).

A lightweight app, privacy-friendly, and completely ad-free.

apps.desc_ar:
‏LimeLog هو متتبّع لتدريب القوة وفق دورات تدريبية مُجدولة.

المزايا:
* بناء برامج تدريب بمراحل
* تسجيل كل مجموعة وكل تكرار
* كشف تلقائي للأرقام الشخصية (معادلة إبلي لـ 1RM)
* مرجع للحمل التدريجي أثناء التسجيل

* الخطوات والسعرات النشطة عبر Health Connect

يعمل محليًا أولًا؛ والمزامنة السحابية اختيارية ومرتبطة بحساب. بلا Google Play Services وبلا Firebase — تسجيل الدخول عبر Google هو تدفّق OAuth عادي على الويب.

✔️ Allows system independent language

apps.desc_ar:
Pachli is a full-featured client for Mastodon and similar servers.

- Read, reply, filter, post, favourite, and boost posts
- Translate posts from other languages
- Your timeline is cached locally, so you can read when offline

- Write posts now, schedule them to send later
- Read and post from multiple accounts
- Multiple themes
- Focused on ensuring all functionality is available to people with accessibility needs
- Open source, https://github.com/pachli

apps.name: PySolFC
apps.summary: مجموعة من ألعاب الورق سوليتير
apps.desc_ar:
PySolFC is a collection of solitaire games written in Python.

PySolFC is a desktop application that runs on Linux, Windows and Mac. It
offers more than 1000 solitaire games such as Patience, Mahjongg, Shishensho,
Memory and others and is published on
https://pysolfc.sourceforge.io.
If you are looking for a desktop version, take a look.

The Android app is based on this work and provides a subset of the desktop
functions. It is created and published from selected snapshots out of
the sources.

If you are looking for a desktop version, take a look.

The Android app is based on this work and provides a subset of the desktop

apps.name: TiefPrompt
apps.summary: تطبيق المُلّقن مفتوح المصدر الأمثل، TiefPrompt
apps.desc_ar:
TiefPrompt هو تطبيق مُلّقن، أي تطبيق لتلقين النص، بسيط للغاية موجّه للمبدعين والمقدمين والمحترفين.
حمّل إخطاطتك من ملف أو ألصقها مباشرة، ثم تحكم بالتشغيل عبر خيارات التشغيل والإيقاف المؤقت وضبط السرعة وقلب الاتجاه.

apps.name: العين الثنائية
apps.summary: تطبيق آخر لمسح الباركود على أندرويد. مجاني، بدون إعلانات، ومفتوح المصدر.
apps.desc_ar:
يعمل في الاتجاهين الرأسي والأفقي، ويمكنه قراءة الرموز المقلوبة، 
ذو تصميم Material ويمكنه أيضًا إنشاء رموز شريطية (باركود).

يستخدم مكتبة ZXing-C++ (المعروفة بـ "Zebra Crossing") لمسح الرموز الشريطية. 
تنسيقات الرموز المدعومة تشمل: 
AZTEC، CODABAR، CODE 39، CODE 93، CODE 128، 
DATA MATRIX، EAN-8، EAN-13، ITF، PDF417، QR CODE، 
RSS 14، RSS EXPANDED، Telepen، UPC-A، UPC-E، وUPC EAN EXTENSION.

هذا التطبيق مفتوح المصدر:
https://github.com/markusfisch/BinaryEye

apps.name: سيجيمي
apps.summary: اتبع أين يذهب جهازك دون أن تتبعك
apps.desc_ar:
It stores GPS coordinates and sends them to your Web server so you can see where is the device.

* You can build your own server (more privacy).
* Send coordinates by Telegram (Bot) and SMS.
* Settings from the website.
* Control over time of activity and downtime to save battery.
* Easy to create accounts without requesting personal data.

It's just a project, so it can only be used for experimental purposes and not for security purposes.

apps.name: mpv-android
apps.summary: الاستماع إلى الموسيقى ومشاهدة مقاطع الفيديو
apps.desc_ar:
mpv-android is a video player for Android based on libmpv.

Features:
* Hardware and software video decoding
* Gesture-based seeking, volume/brightness control and more
* libass support for styled subtitles
* Secondary (or dual) subtitle support
* Advanced video settings (interpolation, debanding, scalers, ...)
* Play network streams with the "Open URL" function
* Background playback, Picture-in-Picture, keyboard input supported

apps.name: Poland can into Space
apps.summary: مساعدة Polandball للوصول إلى الفضاء
apps.desc_ar:
"Poland can into Space" is a simple Android game based on LibGDX framework. The game uses also the Box2D Physics Engine.

In the game, player takes control of Polandball and helps him to reach high altitude and gives him opportunity to GET INTO SPACE!

All what you should do is drawing lines with your finger. Every line creates a trampoline platform. The ball bounces off the trampoline and flies to the top.

apps.summary: يعرض أماكن ركن السيارات المتاحة في المدن الكبرى
apps.desc_ar:
ParkenDD shows you the current parking situation of various European cities, including Basel, Dresden, Ingolstadt and Zurich.
Depending on the available data, you can see the current number of available public parking spots as well as their distance from your current location.
The map button in the lot details shares the lot location with any app that provides maps or navigation.
